analytical_models.model_note: Increasing Nb content strongly raises the MC (NbC) precipitation temperature while only weakly shifting the liquid-to-solid transformation temperature.

parameters.name: NbC precipitation temperature change (0→0.05 wt% Nb)

analytical_models.model_name: C and Al diffusion in austenite
analytical_models.model_note: Nb atoms slightly decrease the diffusion coefficient of C in austenite (strong Nb-C affinity) while slightly increasing the diffusion coefficient of Al; slower C diffusion decelerates κ-carbide nucleation and growth.
